'''Uncle Yun''' is an NPC in [[Jinzhou]]. He can be found roaming near the theater in Jinzhou during the day (06:00-21:59).

==Location== 
{{Map Embed|Jinzhou|95|nogroup=1}}

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Uncle Yun:''' Are you here to watch the Hero Play, or to enjoy the Taiping Musical?
:{{DIcon}} I'm just looking around.
:'''Uncle Yun:''' Well, I suggest you go to the theater for a show and meet with new friends.
:'''Uncle Yun:''' You see, I'm getting old. My time is growing less to enjoy the shows or meet my friends.
:'''Uncle Yun:''' I didn't have much time when I was a soldier. Now that I've retired and have more time, I can't waste a bit.
:'''Uncle Yun:''' You should go and watch the Taiping Musical by the Liondance Troupe if you've got the time. They used to perform for the army, with their impressive skills.
:'''Uncle Yun:''' Now, this stage belongs to these young folks, and watching them gives me a real kick.
----
:'''Uncle Yun:''' Hello, can I help you?
:{{DIcon}} Chat
::(Version 1)
::'''Uncle Yun:''' Just try to spare the gripe, will ya?
::'''Uncle Dong:''' You don't get it. Qinghe should have read her lines like that in the previous scene!
::'''Uncle Yun:''' Oh, don't get all worked up. You should encourage the younger ones. They've been up all night, you know.
::'''Uncle Dong:''' Come on, you've been playing this for so many years. How can you still not get this part right? 
----
::(Version 2)
::'''Uncle Yun:''' There was this kid who was always dreaming of playing the villain. Haven't seen him on stage recently. I'm afraid he didn't get a role in Qinghe's new play.
::'''Uncle Yun:''' With his physique, his demeanor, and his bright, piercing eyes, he's actually perfect for playing the good guy.
::'''Uncle Yun:''' I don't know why, but he's always trying to play the villain.
::'''Uncle Dong:''' But he possesses an energy that reminds me of my younger days.
:{{DIcon|Exit}} Leave
{{Dialogue End}}
